title: Technical diagrams / Node colors — Dark theme

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Dark theme

slide_intent: Adapt node contrast to a dark canvas without losing hierarchy, because outlines, fills, icons and labels must remain distinguishable.
strategic_value: A defined dark-theme role system can keep IBM diagrams readable while preserving their construction vocabulary.
demonstration: On a dark field, two large nodes at left compare side-bar and color-block treatments; two small nodes at right compare outlined and filled versions.
practical_value: Assign primary and secondary colors by element role before choosing a dark-theme node variant.

content_islands.name: Theme selector
content_islands.spec: Show Dark theme selected beside Light theme.

content_islands.name: Large nodes
content_islands.spec: Stack the side-bar and color-block examples on the left, using white labels and contrasting icon treatments.

content_islands.name: Small nodes
content_islands.spec: Stack an outlined and a filled circular node on the right with their labels beneath.

ingredient.name: Dark technical-diagram colors
ingredient.role: Keep node boundaries, labels and icons legible on a dark canvas.
ingredient.application: Use primary colors for outlines, side bars, color blocks and connectors; reserve secondary colors for fills and keep text White.
ingredient.scope: The accompanying dark-theme diagram rules specify Gray 100 canvas, primary grades 30–50 or White and secondary Gray 100/Color 90. Meaning must also be carried by labels, lines or icons.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying color section explains that the role rules support accessibility while retaining flexibility.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue outlines and solid blue regions contrast with the dark canvas and white labels in this captured dark-theme diagram treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: Four node variants show how primary and secondary colors operate across large and small shapes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source sets Gray 100 canvas, White text, primary swatches 30–50 or White and secondary fills Gray 100 or Color 90 for dark-theme diagrams.
